faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Before you start, honest answers
faq.subtitle: The questions our clients ask most before signing.

list.q: Is Soulvd officially licensed by Meta?
list.a: Yes. Soulvd is an officially certified WhatsApp Business partner of Meta since 2026. Your accounts run on the official WhatsApp Business API infrastructure, with full compliance to Meta's security and privacy standards.

list.q: How long until we're actually live?
list.a: Two weeks for most projects — one for discovery and setup, one for testing and launch. Smaller projects can wrap in 3-5 days.
All data is stored in data centers within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, encrypted at rest and in transit. Full compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

list.q: Can I try before I commit?
list.a: Absolutely. We offer a free, no-commitment 45-minute demo with a solutions engineer who runs the bot on your actual data before you pay a single riyal.

about.title: About Soulvd
about.subtitle: Your technical partner in digital transformation
about.intro: Soulvd is a Saudi company specializing in AI automation solutions for businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Officially licensed by Meta as a WhatsApp Business partner since 2026, we serve organizations of all sizes across more than 8 sectors.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To be the #1 technical partner for every Saudi company seeking customer experience automation and full digital transformation — through innovative AI solutions that meet local market needs with high accuracy and competitive cost.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Deliver AI tools that help companies of all sizes improve service and reduce operating costs while ensuring exceptional customer experiences across all digital channels.
